facts.fact: The Ministry of Education's PMDV Dashboard API documentation lists endpoints serving EMIS school statistics, enrolment rates, schools and NST test scores, and a POST endpoint that takes data from agencies by agency code into MongoDB, with development and production base URLs; it does not say which systems feed it or that it is in service.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Ghana (PMDV Development Team)

note: Date is the page's 'Last Updated: 2024'; no exchange partner or in-service statement is given.
